name: cycle-rejected
description: A directed cycle in the restricted DAG (op-root emits, then op-a and op-b hold each other's only remaining in-degree) MUST be rejected (spec/fold.md §1 "Malformed input that contains a directed cycle ... MUST reject" and §4 step 5, |L| != |S|). op-root has no parents in S and is emitted first, so this pins the cycle rule itself rather than merely "a graph with no roots": Kahn's algorithm makes progress before it stalls.
